root: ^For the first time, Sofia’s composure wavers. She looks away for a moment, then back at you, her voice quieter than before.
^The night before she died, Sheila told me something… something I think you need to know. She inhales sharply before speaking the next words. She was pregnant.
^She folds her arms, as if bracing herself, but her voice remains steady.
^She was scared. Not because she didn’t want the child, but because she wasn’t sure how to handle it. She trusted me to help her figure it out. Her fingers tighten against her sleeves.
^I told her she wasn’t alone. That I would stand by her no matter what. And then… the next day, she was gone. She finally looks at you again, her expression unreadable.
^Whoever did this to her, they took more than just one life. Find them.
